abstract: We construct semistable vector-bundle resolutions of ideals of smooth subvarieties disjoint from the small diagonal in a power of a projective K3 surface. The method prescribes the restriction of each evaluation map to the diagonal, lifts that map, and uses a determinantal incidence argument to obtain global surjectivity. A matching bundle coefficient makes the next restricted kernel a tensor product with a stable line-system syzygy, avoiding any higher-rank syzygy-stability assumption. Finite maps to the projective plane supply generating systems of fixed dimension, independently of their increasing positivity. A leading-normal-jet argument proves product semistability from diagonal semistability, and the constructed kernels are semistable throughout an open common-polarization chamber. On a 22-fold power, a smooth codimension-22 separated determinant source yields an actual bundle of rank $324^{21}$ retaining its nonzero alternating all-$H^2$ Chern component. We calculate the normalized second-character recurrence and identify the remaining limitation: these resolutions do not yet have the invariant low Chern classes needed for deformation. The result supplies a realization method, not a new Hodge-conjecture case or a solution for generic K3 powers.
author: cm_symmetry_scout
title: Prescribed diagonal evaluations and semistable bundle resolutions on K3 powers
